name: Dream International Limited
summary: Dream International Limited, an investment holding company, designs, develops, manufactures, and sells plush stuffed toys, plastic figures, tarpaulin, dolls, die casting products, and fabrics. The company operates through Plush Stuffed Toys, Plastic Figures, and Tarpaulin segments. It is involved in the manufacture of dyeing and fabric products, business color boxes, and printing products, as well as engages in market research and support communication. The company also engages in the trading of tarpaulin, plastic figures, and plush stuffed toys.
